summary: Glacier's stone-and-frame lookout, contracted in 1940, built 1945 by conscientious objectors, staffed to 1953, NRHP-listed in 1986.

staffing.status: not staffed since the 1953 fire season

access.note: Backcountry of Glacier National Park; as of 2012 the trail built to the site had long been abandoned

visit.trail_note: The 2012 news story says the trail built to the site has long been abandoned

events.note: Park Service contract with Ole Norden in June 1940; construction not begun by April 1942; released in late 1943
In operation from its construction in 1945
Last fire season; abandoned in favor of aerial detection
Roof and floor repairs funded by a $32,000 grant; firelookout.com calls it restored, the news story calls it stabilization

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 2012 news story reports a man's recollection of a lookout standing by 1942 and guesses 1940 or 1941. Park records show trail work from 1939, construction starting July 23, 1945 and a final construction report in 1945. The story uses 1945.
firelookout.com says the lookout was restored in 2012; the 2012 news story describes stabilization with completion the following year. The story reports both wordings.

notes_for_editor: Construction history is well documented (NRHP nomination and NPS planning file). Current condition and access rest on 2012-era sources; no 2026 source was found. Elevation conflict: NHLR gives 6,810 ft (2,076 m), which matches the brief's 2075.7 m; firelookout.com gives 7244 ft. Not used in the story. The NPS planning file's date is not shown in the fetched text. The Wikipedia Built 1945 infobox matches the nomination. Pages read: 6 (NHLR, Wikipedia, firelookout, NRHP PDF, Whitefish Pilot, NPS planning PDF). Search: 1 query.
